facts.text: The hotel is perched atop one of Amman's seven hills, in the heart of Jordan's capital.
facts.excerpt: a five-star luxury hotel in the heart of Jordan’s capital. Perched atop one of Amman’s seven hills, we invite you to experience breathtaking views

facts.text: The hotel has the city's largest rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: Relax on the city’s largest rooftop terrace

facts.text: The hotel is featured in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide Hotels Collection.
facts.excerpt: Proudly featured in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide Hotels Collection

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is certified with Green Key (FEE), a globally recognised eco-label run by the Foundation for Environmental Education

facts.text: SPA InterContinental has a heated indoor pool, jacuzzi, sauna and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: With a heated indoor pool, jacuzzi, sauna and steam rooms, the SPA InterContinental offers the ultimate spa and health experience for both in house and outside guests

facts.text: SPA InterContinental offers treatments from massages and facials to holistic therapies.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a variety of treatments, from soothing massages and revitalizing facials to holistic therapies tailored to your needs.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with sunbeds, described as a retreat away from the city buzz.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in relaxation at our stunning outdoor pool, a refreshing retreat away from the city buzz. Lounge by the water on our comfortable sunbeds

facts.text: The Atrium, near the main lobby, has a glass ceiling that showcases Amman skies and serves a breakfast buffet of local and international dishes.
facts.excerpt: The Atrium, an inviting eatery located near the main lobby, featuring a glass ceiling that showcases Amman skies. With an extravagant breakfast buffet offering a variety of local and international dishes

facts.text: Burj Al Hamam serves Lebanese home cooking and daily fresh seafood, with dishes such as Kibbeh Nayeh and Shanklish.
facts.excerpt: Experience the essence of Lebanese home cooking and daily fresh seafood. Feast on Kibbeh Nayeh, Shanklish, Kebbeh Sajieh

facts.text: The hotel's restaurants serve Indian, Mexican, Japanese, international and Lebanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy spiced Indian specialties, vibrant Mexican dishes, exquisite Japanese creations, mouthwatering international snacks, and Lebanese cuisine crafted to perfection.
